data.name: Buhaisah
data.gender_notes: Buhaisah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Buhaisah means 'giver of good news'. This name is derived from the root words 'Ba-Ha-Sa', which mean 'good news' or 'gift'. In Islamic tradition, receiving good news is considered a blessing and a source of joy and happiness. The name Buhaisah carries the meaning “Giver of Good News” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Buhaisah usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the joy and happiness of receiving good news from Allah.
data.etymology: Buhaisah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver of Good News.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Buhaisah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
